ritual.ariaLabel: ናብቲ ስርዓት ኣቲኻ - ናብ ቤተ መቕደስ ኦርቢታል ስም ስደድ

footer.credits: ኦርቢታል ቴምፕል Edson Pavoni ዝተሰርሐ ስነ-ጥበባዊ ስርሓት ኮይኑ፡ ምስ Pedro Kaled, João Pedro Polito, Victor Baptista, João Victor Alves, André Biagioni, VK, Jonathan Querubina, Guilherme Bullejos, Eduardo Dias, Roberta Savian Rosa, Clara Marques, Daphne Alves, Flavio Vidigal, Andre Holzmeister, Pedro Vidigal, Tatiane Putti, Rafael Fernandes, Bruna Cairo, Gabriela Veiga, Kate Chapman Specter, Marcello Dantas, Anne Valls, Matias Campos Abad, Samuel Levy, Bella Nardini, Leigh Pennington, Nima Gardideh , ከምኡ’ውን ኩሎም ድሮ ኣስማት ናብዚ ቤተ መቕደስ ዝለኣኹ {{count}} ሰባት ብምትሕብባር ዝተፈጥረ እዩ።
